_comment: Default-deny. Copy to policy.json and edit for your machine; policy.json is gitignored because it describes your filesystem. Write it after reading a scan, not before - an allowlist guessed in advance is theatre.
_allowed_mcp_servers_comment: Empty = default-deny. Fill from the scan's MCP inventory, naming what each server can actually reach.
_accepted_signals_comment: Signals you have decided are fine for these agents. Everything else in scan.SIGNALS is a violation when it appears.
